description.value:
Homebrew: automates the Cave Worm Monstrosity Form's "Inexorable" ability. The real ability text is: "You automatically recover from the Paralyzed, Slowed, and Stunned conditions at the end of each of your turns. You're also immune to being Immobilized and ignore difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain." Immunity to immobilized is already handled by the shared Spell Effect: Monstrosity Form item's own Immunity rule element (vanilla, untouched). Terrain-ignoring isn't automated -- that's a movement-cost mechanic Foundry has no rule-element hook for, left as a manual reminder. This effect's own job is just the per-turn condition recovery, done by scripts/inexorable.js, which hooks the real pf2e.endTurn hook (fired from Combatant#onEndTurn -- confirmed against the compiled system source, not guessed) and, if this effect is present on the actor whose turn just ended, removes any active Paralyzed/Slowed/Stunned condition via actor.conditions.bySlug(slug).

Granted automatically while in Cave Worm Monstrosity Form -- see Spell Effect: Monstrosity Form's own GrantItem rule element (predicate: monstrosity-form:cave-worm). Not meant to be dragged onto a sheet manually.
